title: SDS-PAGE Gel Electrophoresis Protocol
author: Steven J Burgess
license_note: Confirmed via CrossRef DOI metadata: dx.doi.org/10.17504/protocols.io.by6zpzf6
materials: Proceed either directly to Protein Transfer using Bio-rad TransBlot Turbo or Total Protein Staining.

steps.title: Prepare Running Buffer
steps.instruction: Create a 1X working dilution of Tris/Glycine/SDS buffer by diluting 10X stock 1:10 with distilled H2O.

substeps.instruction: Prepare approximately 1 L per gel tank

steps.title: Prepare Protein Samples
steps.instruction: Dilute each sample using 1x PEB to a final concentration of 3 μg/µL of total soluble protein in fresh microcentrifuge tubes.

substeps.instruction: Heat previously frozen protein extracted samples at 50 °C for 5 minutes to help resolubilization of SDS in protein extraction buffer prior to dilution
Briefly vortex the sample to shear any DNA contamination
Prepare a recommended final volume of ~100 µL (sufficient for 10 samples), depending on the application

steps.title: Prepare Electrophoresis Cell
steps.instruction: Assemble the Mini-PROTEAN electrophoresis cell and fill the chambers with buffer.

substeps.instruction: Fill the inner chamber with buffer
Fill the outer chamber up to the recommended mark (volume varies based on whether 2 or 4 gels are being run)

steps.title: Prepare Precast Gel
steps.instruction: Prepare the precast gel for loading.

substeps.instruction: Carefully remove the comb from the precast gel
Remove the tape across the bottom

steps.title: Clean Gel Wells
steps.instruction: Wash the wells with running buffer by pipetting up and down to remove residual acrylamide.

steps.title: Load Samples and Ladder
steps.instruction: Load the protein ladder and samples into the gel wells.

substeps.instruction: Load 3 µL of Chameleon™ Duo Pre-stained Protein Ladder into the first well
Load 10 µL of each sample (30 µg of total soluble protein) per lane

steps.title: Run Electrophoresis
steps.instruction: Run the electrophoresis until samples reach the end of the gel.

substeps.instruction: For precast gels: run at 200 V for ~30 minutes (or until samples reach the end; running chlorophyll off the end may improve fluorescence and signal)
For self-made gels: run at 80-120 V

steps.title: Recover Gel
steps.instruction: Remove the gel from the case and remove the stacking gel.

substeps.instruction: Carefully open the precast gel case using an opening lever, inserting where the black arrows indicate
Remove the stacking gel with a blade
